_meta.notice: FICTIONAL webhook deliveries for the local simulator. Nothing here was received from a real Zendesk account.
_meta.shape: Modeled on Zendesk event-subscription webhooks (type, subject, detail, event, time, id). Field names are simplified; verify against current Zendesk docs before building a real endpoint.

events.name: new_ticket
events.description: A customer opens a new ticket asking where order #1042 is.

events.name: follow_up
events.description: Priya replies to her earlier ticket with the order number we needed.

comment.body: Sorry, forgot to include it. It's order #1044.

events.name: duplicate_delivery
events.description: Zendesk retries the new_ticket delivery (same event id). The simulator must skip it if new_ticket was already processed.

events.name: escalation_worthy
events.description: Jordan's third message about the same missing package: frustrated, repeat contact, refund demand.

comment.body: This is ridiculous. I've contacted you THREE times and my package still hasn't arrived. I want my money back!

events.name: human_request
events.description: A new ticket about a damaged lamp where the customer asks for a person.

detail.subject: Lamp arrived broken - want to talk to a person

events.name: staff_comment
events.description: A Northstar staff member adds a comment. The handler ignores staff-authored comments so the agent never replies to itself or to colleagues.

comment.body: Internal: weather delays across Colorado this week.

events.name: malformed
events.description: A broken delivery with no ticket subject. The handler rejects it during validation.
